functions.name: getSellerHouseRecommendation
functions.simpleDescription: Recommends houses for the saved seller item when asked where to sell.
rules: Require category, dimensions and condition
Do not promise a higher price in one country
Do not contact any auction house

functions.name: getSellerCatalogDraft
functions.simpleDescription: Shows the saved catalog draft without inventing item facts.
rules: Require category, dimensions and condition
Copy the saved catalog draft only; unconfirmed facts remain explicitly unconfirmed

functions.name: getSellerEnquiryPreview
functions.simpleDescription: Prepares an enquiry preview for explicit review and consent.
rules: Require category, dimensions and condition
Use the current profile's saved draft
Do not create a lead, grant consent or contact an auction house

functions.name: getSellerProvenanceAdvice
functions.simpleDescription: Explains why provenance needs verification without promising a price premium.
rules: Do not infer authenticity from an upload
Do not promise a multiplier or change the valuation

functions.name: searchSellerComparables
functions.simpleDescription: Finds similar lots using the seller's saved category and confirmed materials.
rules: Run only on request after category, dimensions and condition are filled
Read the current profile's saved draft; never accept invented lots or prices
Similarity currently uses category and confirmed materials, not dimensions or condition

functions.name: getSellerComparableHistory
functions.simpleDescription: Shows recorded completed sales of similar items, not the seller item's own history.
rules: Run only on request when required intake fields are complete
Use S3 included comparable evidence only; do not treat estimates as realized prices

functions.name: getSellerPriceTrend
functions.simpleDescription: Displays a chronological chart of recorded sale prices of similar items.
rules: Run only on request when required intake fields are complete
Plot completed comparable sales separately per currency
At least two sales per currency are needed; this is not a valuation
Label synthetic development data as DEMO

functions.name: getSellerItemDetails
functions.simpleDescription: Shows the seller's saved item facts; result links open additional details for comparable lots.
rules: Use the current profile and session only
Do not infer missing optional facts

functions.name: getLotSaleHistory
functions.simpleDescription: Loads verified sold records for an item from the database.
whenToUse: The item details screen displays verified sale history
rules: Use the selected lot's real itemKey
For AI routing use getComparableSaleHistory, not this direct screen helper
Do not invent itemKey or historical prices

functions.name: searchLots
functions.simpleDescription: Searches auction lots using the buyer's saved criteria.
functions.description: For normal search B2 dispatches saved criteria to B4/B3. With intent search_similar_lots B2 reuses S3 comparisons using the selected database lot or the latest saved category.
whenToUse: The buyer requests a lot search and required search criteria are complete
rules: Return intentRoute.functionName=searchLots with readyForFunction=true
B2 reads saved criteria; do not send or invent lots

functions.name: getPriceTrend
functions.simpleDescription: Shows price evidence for the latest buyer search results.
functions.description: B2 supplies the previous B3 result IDs to Batya's presentation service, which loads verified lot prices.
whenToUse: The buyer requests a price trend for the latest search results
functions.returns: PriceTrendPoint[] with resolved lots via chat callback
rules: Require previous search result IDs in conversation context
Return intentRoute.functionName=getPriceTrend with readyForFunction=true and arguments={}
Use sold lots with realized prices in the same currency; do not invent prices or run a new search

functions.name: calculateSellerValuation
functions.simpleDescription: Calculates a seller item valuation from comparable sale evidence.
whenToUse: The seller explicitly requests a valuation after category, dimensions and condition are provided
functions.returns: Supported valuation report or an explicit refusal reason
rules: Send functionToRun=calculateSellerValuation and object={sessionId} inside structuredAnswer
The workflow loads the saved draft for the current profile
Do not invent item identifiers, sale evidence or prices

functions.name: createSellerLeadDraft
functions.simpleDescription: Creates a seller request draft for internal use.
functions.description: Creates an internal seller lead draft. Does not contact an auction house.
whenToUse: The seller wants to proceed with an internal service request
Contact details and explicit service consent are available
rules: Require name
Require email or phone
Require serviceConsent=true
Does not contact an auction house automatically

functions.name: rankSellerHouses
functions.simpleDescription: Ranks auction houses for sellers and buyers.
functions.description: Ranks auction houses without storing a lead. Buyer routing invokes the same service and displays only active category specialists.
whenToUse: The seller asks which auction house is suitable
The seller asks for recommended auction houses
rules: Do not invent recommendations
Use only provided house data

functions.name: rankAndStoreSellerHouses
functions.simpleDescription: Ranks auction houses and saves the result on a seller lead.
functions.description: Ranks auction houses and stores the ranking on an existing seller lead.
whenToUse: A seller lead already exists and the ranking should be stored on it
rules: Require leadId
Use only provided house data

functions.name: chooseSellerHouse
functions.simpleDescription: Saves the auction house chosen by the seller.
functions.description: Stores the auction house explicitly selected by the seller without overwriting the recommendation.
whenToUse: The seller explicitly selects an auction house
rules: Require leadId
Require an explicit seller choice

functions.name: submitFinalSellerLead
functions.simpleDescription: Finalizes a seller lead with item and valuation details.
functions.description: Finalizes the internal seller lead with catalog data, item data, evidence references, and valuation or refusal.
whenToUse: The seller lead is ready to be finalized
rules: Require leadId
Does not automatically contact an auction house

functions.name: listSellerLeads
functions.simpleDescription: Lists the seller leads available to the user.
whenToUse: A list of seller leads is requested

functions.name: getSellerLead
functions.simpleDescription: Shows the details of one seller lead.
functions.description: Returns detailed information for one seller lead.
whenToUse: Details of a specific seller lead are requested

functions.name: listEvidence
functions.simpleDescription: Lists the image files uploaded for a seller profile.
functions.description: Returns all evidence images for a seller profile in their stored order.
whenToUse: The seller asks to view uploaded images
Current evidence references are needed
rules: Do not interpret image contents

functions.name: uploadEvidence
functions.simpleDescription: Uploads a new image for a seller profile.
functions.description: Uploads a new evidence image for a seller profile and returns its reference.
whenToUse: The seller uploads or adds a new image
rules: Do not interpret image contents

functions.name: getEvidenceFile
functions.simpleDescription: Downloads one stored image for a seller profile.
functions.description: Returns one stored evidence file for a seller profile.
whenToUse: A specific stored seller image file is requested

functions.name: reorderEvidence
functions.simpleDescription: Changes the order of a seller's uploaded images.
functions.description: Updates the order of evidence images for a seller profile.
whenToUse: The seller wants to change image order

functions.name: deleteEvidence
functions.simpleDescription: Deletes one image from a seller profile.
functions.description: Deletes one evidence image and its metadata for a seller profile.
whenToUse: The seller asks to remove a specific uploaded image

functions.name: getLotById
functions.simpleDescription: Shows the full details of one auction lot.
functions.description: Returns the full details of a selected auction lot.
whenToUse: The buyer asks for item details
The buyer opens a specific selected lot
The buyer clicks 'פרטי פריט'
rules: Require a selected lot id
Do not infer missing lot facts

functions.name: getComparableSaleHistory
functions.simpleDescription: Finds earlier sales of the same item.
functions.description: Returns previous sold records for the exact same physical item, identified by itemKey, in the same currency and sorted by sale date.
whenToUse: The buyer asks for previous sales of the selected item
The buyer asks for sale history

inputs.selectedLot: { id: string, itemKey?: string } | optional when supplied by conversation context

optionalInputs.lots: { id: string }[] | B2 can load verified history from the database

rules: Return intentRoute.functionName=getComparableSaleHistory with readyForFunction=true
A selected lot id must exist; B2 resolves its itemKey from verified data
A preferred currency must be available
Exclude the selected lot itself
Use only lots with the same itemKey
status must be sold
realizedPrice must exist
realizedPrice currency must match the selected lot preferred currency
Sort by saleDate from oldest to newest
The function may return 0, 1, or more results
The PriceHistory UI, not this function, decides that fewer than 2 results is insufficient history
